notes.title: Back in Action - With Even Hotter News
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]As some of you may have heard, the adult games scene has been going through some turbulence lately with banks and payment processors. A bunch of +18 titles have recently been pulled from both Itch and even Steam, and even well-known payment processors have been refusing to process payments for this category in certain currencies…[/p][p]Right in the middle of all this, the Compliance team from the payment provider that handles the money we get from Steam decided to freeze our funds. For two weeks, we were stuck in limbo while they investigated — they wanted to trace the exact source of the money and get all the details about our product. If you noticed that the Shale Hill Secrets page here on Steam suddenly lost all its explicit images and videos during that time… yeah, that’s why. We were genuinely worried about getting banned by the bank and losing access to our funds, which would most likely lead us to bankruptcy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003585/5eea972735f1ea4757fc87c65339cb2d09f10baa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The good news? As of today, the bank’s Compliance department has cleared us and unfrozen our account! This means the game (and our bank account) is safe, and we can keep making content without fear of any sudden shutdowns (at least for now!)[/p][p]So, the explicit images are now back on the game’s page — and while we were at it, we slipped in a few fresh, [i]spicier[/i] CGs ;)[/p][p]On top of that, we’re hard at work finishing up the Shale Hill Secrets DLCs that will unlock the Extra Bonus Scenes and the Epilogues. Keep your eyes peeled — our next post will have more info on all that juicy new content![/p][p]Stay foxy,
The Love-Joint Team [/p]

notes.title: Video Fixes, Auto-Forward & More Quality of Life Updates!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,

We're back with another update packed with fixes and features that you requested. Your incredible feedback has been driving our development, and we couldn't be more grateful.

[/p][h1]Animations [/h1][p]
First up: those pesky animation issues. We've completely re-encoded all in-game videos to a more compatible format, which should put an end to those crashes a few players have been experiencing. Please, let us know how the animations are running in this latest build (0.18.20 or newer).

[/p][h1]Auto-Forward [/h1][p]
The feature you've been asking for the most is finally here. Auto-forward lets the text advance automatically – just look for the button in the text box (bottom left). Want to customize the speed? Head over to Settings > Gameplay Settings and make it perfect for your reading pace.

[/p][h1]Borderless Fullscreen [/h1][p]
Fullscreen mode now runs borderless, which means you can enjoy the full-screen experience while easily alt-tabbing between applications. Multi-monitor users, this one's especially for you!
[/p][p]Thank you to every single player who took the time to share feedback with us. Your input is what makes each update meaningful.

Stay Foxy, 
The Love-Joint Team.
[/p]

notes.title: Solution For Video Crashes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We've noticed that a few players are experiencing issues with animations causing the game to freeze or crash. To address this, we've introduced an alternative animation system using image strips, which should help prevent these issues. You can also choose to disable animations entirely if needed.

[b]Note:[/b] If you're not experiencing any issues with the animations, there's no need to change your current animation settings.

[h2]To switch to the new animation system:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Go to the main menu and click on Settings.
[*] Select Video Options.
[*] Under Animation, choose "Strips."
[/olist]
Please let us know if this solution works for you.

With Love, 
The Love-Joint Team.

notes.title: Animation Issues & macOS Achievements
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update addresses the achievements bug on macOS (you'll have to replay to trigger achievements) and adds new checks for video playback. 

If you're experiencing crashes during animations, you'll now receive a better error report that can be screenshotted. Plus, the game will generate a debug.txt file in %appdata% if it crashes, which you can send to us.

[b]To find the log file after a crash:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Right-click on Shale Hill Secrets in your Steam Library.
[*] Select Properties...
[*] Go to Installed Files.
[*] Click Browse (this opens the game’s install directory).
[*] Click on Saves Location shortcut.
[*] If the game crashed, the debug.txt file should be there.
[*] Email the file to support@love-joint.com.
[/olist]

[b]If Animations Are Crashing:[/b]
Try adjusting the game's refresh rate to match your monitor's. If not available, set it to "Free."
[olist]
[*] In the main menu, click Settings.
[*] Go to Video Options.
[*] Choose Refresh Rate.
[*] Set it to your display's rate or "Free" if not available.
[/olist]
We're working on an alternative animation system to address these issues some players are experiencing. 
Thanks for your help and patience! We’re excited to smooth out these bugs and prepare the game for more content!

Stay Foxy,
The Love-Joint Team.

notes.title: Shale Hill Secrets development update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, how's it going?

We wanted to say hello and let you know we haven't forgotten about Steam! We're still working and adjusting some things to launch the game here. Unfortunately, we’re having some headaches that every game developer faces along the way…

To be more specific, some parts of the game's original code need updating and reworking for this platform, but it's nothing too serious and we're already finishing up with all of that. We're also taking the opportunity to touch up the animations, remastering all of them, increasing the videos resolution, improving the loops, and, especially, tweaking the sound effects.

Anyway, we're a very small team and some tasks end up taking more time than we expected, but the game is 95% ready for Steam and very soon we'll have a launch date.
Stay tuned and thanks for your interest!
